title: Completed integral twist lines commute with finite scalar base change
statement: Let $\ell$ be a prime and $S$ be a scheme on which $\ell$ is invertible [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], let $E\subset F$ be finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, with completed coefficient sheaves $R_E=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,S}$ and $R_F=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{F,S}$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], and let $T=\mathbf Z_\ell(1)_S$ be the rank-one twist sheaf of [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Use the canonical identifications from the defining formula in [def-coefficient-twists-detailed] and clause 3 of [lem-pur-twist-sheaf-locally-free], namely $\mathcal O_H(1)\cong T\otimes_{\widehat{\mathbf Z}_{\ell,S}}R_H$ for $H=E,F$, with $\mathcal O_H(m)$ formed by tensor powers for $m\geq0$ and sheaf duals [def-pur-sheaf-hom] for $m<0$. Then there are canonical isomorphisms of $R_F$-modules, natural in $S$, $$\mathcal O_E(m)\otimes_{R_E}R_F\xrightarrow{\sim}\mathcal O_F(m)$$ for every $m\in\mathbf Z$. For $m\geq0$ they are induced by tensor associativity, and for $m<0$ they are induced by the base-change map on sheaf duals; these isomorphisms are compatible with evaluation, tensor powers, and the inclusions in a tower $E\subset F\subset G$.
